brief_rationale: The trajectory successfully completed all 8 responsibility-chain items without any serious or minor errors, including comprehensive red-flag screening, correction of misunderstandings about lupus anticoagulant testing and anesthesia, clear risk communication about delay, formation of an executable action plan with question checklist, and closed-loop confirmation through patient teach-back. Additionally, two high-order points were meaningfully completed (HO1 for patient state-sensitive communication addressing anesthesia fear and involving family; HO4 for discovering multiple non-volunteered barriers). The closure is safe, executable, and traceable with valid transition milestone to inpatient team.
